entry_points.text: Boot builds base null mount plus mutable root, stacks, registers tree in initial namespace, makes kthread mounts, points init task root/pwd at private mount.
Early prep inits guards, super table, kernfs root plus sysfs, dio slab with panic on failure, drop_caches sysctl, and tmpfs root selection.
Lookup by super plus number returns referenced stable inode or null; wait clears partially-initialized entries; accessor returns filesystem-root node.

exports.text: Swap fs root/pwd by referencing new path, exchanging under exclusive sequence guard, releasing old; bump mnt namespace refcount for init task.
Create kernfs root with id state, guards, lists, callbacks, top node, waitqueue, optional activation; get/put null-tolerant, warn from zero, reclaim on last put upward.
Activate/remove whole subtrees under hierarchy exclusion, removal also under shared superblock guard; removal null-tolerant, per-node work delegated.
Direct-IO entry validates alignment, handles beyond-size reads, coordinates locks/writeback, drives map/submit/flush/complete, returning length/zero/errno/queued.
Walk live supers invoking callback with opaque arg under shared superblock protection.
Signal eventfd with saturating increment and wake input pollers plus caller mask while blocking reentrancy.

hazards.text: Boot treats failure of base/mutable/private mounts, file-rooted stand-in, mountpoint lock for stacking, or super-table init as fatal.
Diagnostics flag inc from zero, put off biased rest, drain of active, activate without bias, leftover mapped/release opens after drain, destroy of non-empty xattr cache.
Wait paths may sleep under fine-grained guards, needing sleepable context and retry tolerance for eviction and hash churn.
Page and bio faults defer and may be superseded by progress; zero substitution can mask errors; paths assert attach retry success, nonzero chunks, cursor bounds, and no early queued status.
Counter saturates at max u64; poll shows readable plus error at saturation and hides writable near it, requiring producer backpressure and consumer drain.

invariants.text: Boot uses base id 1 and mutable root id 2, namespace root on base, kthread root unmountable read-only, plus private writable internal mount on regular stand-in.
Identity pairs root high part with cyclic low from 1, wrap bumps high; wide builds use full identity as ino else low half; kind is masked flags, one build always zero.

New node is single-ref, biased, cleared linkage, copied name, given mode/flags, optional aux ownership, held parent plus security init with ordered cleanup; setattr touches only masked fields, mode in node, owner/times in on-demand aux.
Descendant walk is postorder under hierarchy exclusion ending at start; detach succeeds once per node, adjusting dir count and bumping parent rev under attr guard before clearing linkage.
Xattr teardown removes first entry from hash/list with optional space tally then deferred free; cache destroy warns if non-empty, tears down hash, clears owner.
Bucket mixes number with super address via primes/shifts/mask; nlink clearing walks all supers clearing only where an in-memory inode is found.

Setup validates alignment, handles empty/beyond-size reads, locks/waits as needed, forces sync for sync/extending writes; direct count brackets IO, dsync/sync forces range sync, teardown flushes and gates queued.

Status prefers transfer with short-read cut, suppresses faults after progress, allows callback override then invalidate; block acquire refuses creation for in-size hole writes and propagates deferral.

Bios set completion, pin pages, copy hints, assign sectors, ref before submit, reap with errors; deferred page flushes on gap, coalesces contiguous ranges, boundary forces flush; new sub-blocks zero once.

Mask low bits select pagecache/slab work, high bit latches message suppression; handler uses bounded int helper then drains locality and walks supers/slab logging once; direction helpers give forward/reverse super order.
Destroy frees numeric id only when valid; release wakes hangup first; poll queues then samples for readable/error/writable; drain under lock returns one in semaphore mode else full counter.

locks.text: Root/pwd writers use exclusive sequence guard, referencing new before and releasing old after, readers retry on concurrent change.
Shape mutation needs exclusive hierarchy guard, full removal also shared superblock guard; attr work uses attr guard; drain drops guards while waiting then reacquires reversed.

Id alloc uses root spin with preload; open state uses hashed mutex pool by address with asserted dereference; release needs node mutex; parent stable only under hierarchy/rename exclusion or zero refcount.

Nlink clear holds super-list guard read-mode across lookups; hash search asserts spin held/not-held per flag; new/freeing waits use per-inode spin plus bit queue, dropping guards to sleep and revalidating.
Dio refcount/chain/waiter use dedicated spin irq-safe with atomic last-drop; open-node derivation and naming use RCU with emptiness/root-lock predicates.

Pagecache drop walks super inodes under list lock, skips transient entries, refs then invalidates whole mapping after unlock with yield; super walk pins next, takes passive ref, calls back under super lock unless unlocked.
Signal/removal hold waitqueue lock irq-saved with reentrancy check, saturating update, conditional wake; poll queues callback then full barrier pairing insertion with readiness tests.

state_machines.text: Nodes start biased deactivated; activation marks descendants then clears bias once for nodes neither active nor hidden nor removing.
Removal flags subtree removing and re-biases actives, drains leftmost descendant under temp ref, unlinks once with parent upkeep, ending after original target.
Open drain runs only with mapped/release-pending shared opens; pass unmaps and invokes release expecting zero before unlock; teardown idempotent via released marker.
Discovery separates absent/stable/new/freeing/creating: wait for new, rewait and rescan for freeing, stale for creating, discard unhashed with retry.
Lifetime counts submissions plus base ref, wakes sync waiter at one, at zero completes inline or via workqueue when deferral or mapped-page hazards need process context.
Page supply keeps head/tail with byte bounds, refills from iterator, substitutes shared zero page on write fault with mapped blocks recording first fault, discard unpins remainder.
Main loop walks pages/blocks to final block: bounds bytes, maps extents, handles holes by zero-fill for reads or buffered fallback for writes, clamps chunks, submits with monotonic checks.

structs.text: Root bundles cyclic id state plus guard, hierarchy/attr/super guards, super list, rename guard, top dir node, callbacks/flags, deactivation queue, xattr cache with deferred free.

Node bundles wide identity, ref/active counters, ordered linkage, refcounted name, mode/flags, parent, optional aux attrs/times/xattrs, child linkage with counts/rev, symlink target, open state, validation state, free linkage.

Submit cursor holds geometry, position, map callback, staging, iterator, bounded queue with hints; control holds identity, inode/size, completion, pin/dirty, errors, refcount, chain, waiter, async result, page-or-work union; 64 pages, async 1, invalidate 2.
Context holds refcount, sleeper queue, 64-bit counter, flags with semaphore mode, numeric id; updates under queue lock, poll ordered with insertion.

Xattr space is 40 plus payload plus name independent of word size; null stand-in uses ino 2 (root 1), regular widely-writable, dedicated ops, synced times, no atime; drop_caches is write-only int 1..4.
